remarks:
Perched on the hillside overlooking CHQ Lake, this charming home has the cozy appeal of a Swiss chalet, with 8 ft of deeded lake access, beautiful lake views, in a wooded setting. Offering 4 BD & 2 BA, this home has modern conveniences and comfort.
The main level has an open concept. Step into the nicely appointed kitchen where sliding glass doors lead to the deck. Enjoy casual meals at the kitchen island or grill & dine el-fresco in the summer months while taking in the lake views. Back inside you'll find the dining room & living room quiet & comfortable overlooking the yard & lake. The living room is highlighted by beautiful beveled glass windows & stained glass door that add warmth & personality. Enjoy cozy evenings around the fireplace! A large modern full bath complete this floor.
The 2nd floor offers 3 BD including the primary where you'll wake each morning to lake views framed by a wall of windows. This bedroom is flooded with natural light & offers a spacious cedar closet & add'l nook providing functional bonuses to this inviting space. Two add'l BD grace this level, complimented by a large modern bath. Abundant windows capture serene outdoor & lake views. The laundry area is also located here. The stained glass window in the hallway adds a touch of charm & character to the space.
The 3rd floor bedroom is a charming, private retreat w/ built-in shelving along 1 wall & built-in closet. Slanted ceilings enhance the cozy chalet feel.
Step outside onto the wrap-around deck, where there's plenty of space for dining, morning coffee, entertaining, or simply relaxing & enjoying the ever-changing lake views. In the evening, gather around the fire pit to enjoying stories & starlit nights.
The adorable shed is the ideal spot for storing lawn & lake gear, the attached 1-car garage includes a workspace for projects & hobbies.
With its distinctive character, lake views, inviting outdoor spaces & charm, this is a home that feels like a special retreat! Make it your year round residence, a cherished summer home or weekend getaway, it's the perfect setting for every season! Don't miss your opportunity to make this unique hillside Chautauqua Lake property your own!
